exit 0
--- stdout
Strict admission skips canonical commands an Acceptance Contract defers or an
operator ruling defers. The engine runs them as one batch at integration HEAD
every config.deferred_validation.batch_every_merges merges (default 5) and
before global integration, and bisects a failing command over the merges since
it last passed. A red batch records an immediate discovery naming the culprit
task, which wakes the orchestrator.
rule, unrule, retire, settle and abort are operator-only. run and status are open.
Usage:
liza deferred-validation [command]
Available Commands:
abort End the live deferred-validation batch
retire Remove an obsolete command from the deferred-validation set
rule Defer an exact canonical command for every strict task listing it
run Run the deferred-validation batch at integration HEAD
settle Clear a predecessor runner that did not finish
status Show deferred commands, rulings, the runner and recent batches
unrule Withdraw an operator ruling
Flags:
-h, --help help for deferred-validation
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza deferred-validation [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
